benchmarks_common_fields.source: Home Office, Economic and social costs of crime 2019 to 2020 (Table 1/3/4)
benchmarks_common_fields.usage_rule: Unit costs are per ALL crimes (reported + unreported). To use with police-recorded-crime volumes, FIRST multiply PRC by the multiplier in notes. Consider excluding the anticipation component for marginal crime reductions (individuals don't cancel burglar alarms over small changes).

benchmarks.notes: REPLACES v1 homicide row. Multiplier 1.00 (all homicides recorded). 673 offences; £2.3bn total.
Multiplier 2.78. Highest non-fatal unit cost. Physical/emotional harms component £26,340.
Multiplier 18.07 — huge under-reporting; never use raw PRC volumes.
